dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Strongly concave trailing edge spline with multiple irregular indentations (notches) distributed along the margin from the midpoint to the apex.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Rounded morphology with a medium pixel radius; lacks acute or squared termination.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Linear anterior margin oriented at approximately 35 to 40 degrees relative to the horizontal body axis.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: The visible base width of the fin is approximately 1.8 times the vertical height from the base to the apex.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Multiple distinct notches on the trailing edge; series of fine horizontal linear scratches on the upper posterior quadrant; extensive white punctate scarring and depigmentation patches across the lower lateral surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Dense white stippling and splash-like pigmentation patterns covering the majority of the lower half of the dorsal fin.
